## Description

Programme: MDV-P1-E12 · UX programme: safe, cohesive clinic workspace (from the Nov 2026 product UX audit). Created from the mobile simulator audit of MDV-P5-053, findings M-05, M-09.

Findings and evidence: docs/product-ux-audit/13-mobile-simulator-audit.md, findings M-05, M-09, with screenshots of synthetic cast data in docs/product-ux-audit/evidence/mobile-simulator.
Components affected: packages/ui-native Button disabled state; the patient Messages composer. No new component.
Prerequisites and blocked by: MDV-P5-053. Not in the pilot flow: the pilot runs on the web app.
Clinical sign-off: Not required.
Deliberately NOT in this ticket: real data in the apps (MDV-P5-033) and store builds.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a disabled action, when it is shown, then its reason is visible as text under it, not only in the accessibility hint
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a disabled button, when contrast is computed, then its label meets 4.5:1 with colours from tokens, not opacity
- [ ] **AC3.** Given sending is not available, when Messages opens, then the field cannot take text that would be lost

## Test notes

- ui-native or app unit tests for the changed behaviour; a simulator check recorded on the PR with synthetic data only.

## Notes / open questions

- Regression risk: low.
